questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All phones are TVs.

Some TVs are cars.

Some big are cars.

Conclusions:

I. Some TVs are phones.

II. Some big are TVs.

III. All big are cars.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.

questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All phones are TVs.

Some TVs are cars.

Some big are cars.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36e78ec8b2c524fb753df11e0bd02bd184f7b56701aa96ccf035b2f8332538a8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02fd258bc1a519eb2c64f3247e4e9e894b73d706170473ce5f13ce6e316cba5f.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some TVs are phones. - **True **(because All phones are TVs given. So, Some TVs are phones too)

II. Some big are TVs. - **False **(because there is no direct relation between big and TVs. So, it can be possible but not definite)

III. All big are cars. - False (because Some big are cars given. So, it can be possible but not definite).

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusions I follows".**

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if '+' and '×' are interchanged and '−' and '÷' are interchanged?

95 − 19 × 4 + 6 ÷ 16 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

After decoding signs:

 
 

 Signs
 Decoded signs
 
 

 ÷
 -
 
 

 -
 ÷
 
 

 ×
 +

 ×
 
 

 

Given equation: 95 − 19 × 4 + 6 ÷ 16 = ?

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ __**95 ÷ 19**__ + 4 × 6 - 16 = ?

⇒ ? = 5 + __**4 **____**×**____** 6**__ - 16

⇒ ? = __**5 + 24**__ - 16

⇒ ? = __**29 - 16**__ = 13

Hence, the correct answer is "13".

questions.question: 80 is related to 99 following certain logic. Following the same logic, 0 is related to 3. To which of the following numbers is 35 related, following the same logic? (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

**Logic: n² - 1.**

Now,

80 is related to 99

→ 9² - 1 = 81 - 1 = 80,

→ 10² - 1 = 100 - 1 = 99,

0 is related to 3

→ 12 - 1 = 1 - 1 = 0,

→ 22 - 1 = 4 - 1 = 3,

Similarly, for **35 and 49**

**→ 62 - 1 = 36 - 1 = 35,**

**→ 72 - 1 = 49 - 1 = 48.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Their is a logic followed here, logic is n²-1 and next is (n+1)² -1 

Like:- 35 is 6² -1 then for next number (n+1)² -1

questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/deleting/multiplying etc., to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(96, 29)

(112, 33)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (2nd number × 3) + (2nd number - 20) = 1st number.

Now,

For, 96 : 29

⇒ (29 × 3) + (29 - 20) = 87 + 9 = 96.

For, 112 : 33

⇒ (33 × 3) + (33 - 20) = 99 + 13 = 112.

Similarly, for 188 : 52

**⇒ (52 × 3) + (52 - 20) = 156 + 32 = 188.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
